title: Vic Fangio, Jalen Carter see a faster Jalen Hurts this summer

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Vic Fangio, Jalen Carter see a faster Jalen Hurts this summer
sources.description: Eagles defensive coordinator Vic Fangio has been squaring off with Jalen Hurts in practices for a few years now and that makes him a good source to find out if there's anything different about the quarterback heading into this season.
